useCase: Zero-shot and few-shot 检测 of AI生成的 content 跨 multiple generator types
mechanism: Encodes the input image using CLIP's ViT-L/14 vision encoder to produce a 768-dimensional 特征 vector. A trained linear probe classifier then determines whether the semantic 特征 match 模式 typical of AI生成的 content. Leverages CLIP's understanding of visual-semantic relationships.
accuracy: 高 - 85-93% 跨 diverse AI generators
name: 基于CLIP的AI检测
source: Radford et al. (2021) - Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision, ICML
parameters: Backbone: ViT-L/14, Feature dim: 768, Classifier: linear probe, Input size: 224x224, Preprocessing: center crop + normalize
description: Leverages OpenAI CLIP vision-语言模型 以检测 semantic 不一致 之间 image content and expected real-world properties. 使用 对比度ive learning for zero-shot 检测.

references.title: Radford, A. et al. (2021). Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision. ICML.
Ojha, U. et al. (2023). Towards Universal Fake Image Detectors that Generalize Across Generative Models. CVPR.

strengths:
• Excellent generalization 跨 AI generators
• Captures high-level semantic 不一致
• Pre-trained on massive dataset (400M image-text pairs)
• Works well without fine-tuning
limitations:
• Requires significant computational resources
• May not catch low-level pixel 伪影
• Performance varies with image 分辨率
• Large model size (~900MB)
